clue.text: Two Greek characters left note about "right bloomer"

explanation.definitionFit: The primula, a genus including primroses and cowslips, is a flowering plant, so it is literally something that blooms.

clue.text: Like this setter, confused its lead with lead (Pb)

clue.text: … member of 60s group, one of the Seekers
